$description: THE SHAPE tier — the DATA-SHAPE axis of FFF (the second face, beside `answers`' function and `span`'s form). ONE home for the shape vocabulary (ADR-0017 write-once). Metas carry `shape: "<value>"` as an ADDRESS into this file — never an inline definition, never a value invented at the point of use. CLOSED by s254-D2 item 1 (Dave, #254, "just go for it"): before that ruling `shape` was a free string that resolved against nothing, which the schema itself declared as an UNPROVEN; it is now a store with a resolver, on the chart-intents.json / roles.json pattern. Adding a value is Dave's ruling, never a lane's drift. Equality of shape strings is what the resolver's `instead-of` grade compares (knowledge/_validate_roles_resolve.py `derive()`), so two components with the SAME value are declaring themselves candidates to swap — a collision here is a claim, not an accident.
$grammar: `<x-dimension> × <mark>` — page B's grammar (s254-D1 call B4), now the ONLY grammar. LEFT of the ×: what varies along the primary dimension (`categories`, `time-series`, `bins`, `periods`, `points`, `rows`, `one-measure`, `one-state`, `ancestor-path`, `destination-set`, or `no-data` for a component that takes no data at all). RIGHT of the ×: what is drawn per unit of it (`frequency`, `ohlc`, `series`, `links`, `value-and-delta`, `dot-and-label`, …). The multiplication sign is U+00D7 with a space either side. ONE value predates the grammar and is kept verbatim rather than re-cut, because s254-D1 kept page B's thirteen chart values AS AUTHORED: `parts-of-whole`, shared deliberately by chart-donut and chart-pie (the collision IS the claim — the two are substitutes, separated only by whether a centre total is printed).

$provenance.grammar: s254-D1 call B4 (reviews/META-TAGS-B-2026-09-07-v1.html §16), kept as authored
$provenance.re-cut: the eleven page-A values (reviews/META-TAGS-A-2026-09-07-v1.html) were re-cut into the grammar at #254 build lane S; each meta's MEANING is preserved and the `when` predicate that quoted the old value was updated in the same edit
$provenance.resolver: knowledge/_validate_roles_resolve.py check 9 `shape-known` — an unknown value refuses, loud and named

$extension: EXPECTED, by ruling only. A new component whose data shape is genuinely new PROPOSES a value on a review page; Dave rules it in. A lane that needs a value not listed here does NOT add one — it reports the gap.

no-data × control.definition: Takes no data at all: a label and an action. The trigger family.
no-data × control.$note: s254-D1 call A8 kept button on a "no data" shape; the re-cut preserves that reading as the x-dimension `no-data` and names the mark.

no-data × arbitrary-blocks.definition: Takes no data of its own; arranges whatever blocks it is given, painting nothing.
no-data × arbitrary-blocks.$note: s254-D1 call A8: layout-utilities carries the arbitrary-blocks reading. Re-cut keeps it and states the no-data left half explicitly.

no-data × page-regions.definition: Takes no data of its own; holds the named regions of a page (masthead, nav, main, aside, footer).

no-data × title-and-optional-action.definition: Takes no data of its own; a title band, optionally with actions or tabs riding it.

one-state × dot-and-label.definition: One state value, drawn as a mark plus its word.

one-measure × value-and-delta.definition: One measure and its movement — no series behind it.
one-measure × value-and-delta.$note: Deliberately shares its x-dimension with kpi-tile and runway-bar and is separated by the MARK: the three are substitutes in headline-metric, gated by `when` (series present / commitments to net off).

one-measure × value-delta-and-series.definition: One measure, its movement, and the shape of its change drawn inline.

one-measure × committed-vs-balance-split.definition: One measure split against what is already committed against it, with the remainder (the buffer) as the reading.

rows × name-value-pairs.definition: N rows, each a name and its value.

rows × measure-target-bands.definition: N rows, each one measure against a target plus qualitative performance bands.

ancestor-path × links.definition: An ordered path from root to here, each step a link.

destination-set × links.definition: A flat or shallow set of destinations, each a link.

categories × series.definition: Categorical x-dimension, one or more series drawn per category (grouped or stacked).

categories × two-series-mirrored.definition: Categorical x-dimension, exactly two series mirrored about a shared centre or baseline.

categories × five-number-summary.definition: Categorical x-dimension, each category carrying median · IQR · whiskers · outliers.

bins × frequency.definition: Contiguous bins of ONE variable, each carrying a count.

periods × ohlc.definition: Ordered periods, each carrying open · high · low · close.

points × two-measures.definition: Unordered observations, each carrying two quantitative measures.

shared-x × two-measures-different-units.definition: One shared x-dimension, two measures in DIFFERENT units read against it.

time-series × 1–5-series.definition: One continuous time axis, one to five series on it, axes present.

time-series × single-series-no-axes.definition: One continuous time axis, one series, NO axes — an inline trend.

time-series × parts-of-whole.definition: One continuous time axis, cumulative bands sharing one total at every point.

parts-of-whole.definition: Parts that sum to a whole, no x-dimension — a snapshot split.
parts-of-whole.$note: PRE-GRAMMAR value, kept VERBATIM under s254-D1 (page B's thirteen chart values stand as authored). The donut/pie collision is DELIBERATE: they are substitutes separated only by whether a centre total is printed (chart-donut 80 beats chart-pie 48 whenever it is).
